optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Site Project Coordinator, Solar Farm Construction

professionalSummary.text: Keeps the construction schedule current with subcontractor progress on a live construction site.
professionalSummary.witness: Site project coordinator on two utility-scale solar farm sites for a construction contractor over three years, keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Records the daily site diary and the permit-to-work register under the site procedures.
experienceHighlights.witness: Recorded the daily site diary and the permit-to-work register under the site procedures, with both audited quarterly by the site health and safety adviser without findings.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Prepares the weekly progress report for the developer's site representative.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Prepared the weekly progress report for the developer's site representative, with the reports and the representative's comments filed in the site folder.

skills.text: Tracks material deliveries against the schedule and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Tracked the material deliveries against the schedule in the delivery log, recording which delivery queries I resolved with the suppliers and which needed the site project manager's site instruction.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in solar farm construction, including schedule management, diary and permit-to-work register recording, weekly progress reporting, material tracking, and milestone hand-over documentation. They do not establish the candidate's ability to work with subcontractors, health and safety advisers, or the developer's site representative.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience and work samples demonstrate the required skills for the Site Project Coordinator role, but further human review is required to assess the candidate's suitability based on the evidence provided.
